A Snapshot of Your Day

As Senior Technical Project Manager you will lead and manage the substation engineering work for onshore substations, offshore wind projects, Power-to-X (PtX) technologies, and energy transmission projects in general. That means you can be involved from the bidding process, all the way through the project execution until the warranty is concluded and the project is handed over on to service.

You will be the Technical Project Manager resource for sales opportunities and for project execution. Therefore, you can simultaneously work in sales opportunities and projects. Besides the sales and project teams, you will have a close collaboration with our Project Management department, procurement function as well as our international business units. By joining us you will become part of a continuously growing team of passionate Technical Project Managers and Engineers.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Coordinate overall single-line diagram for the substations and overall substation layouts together with our 3D team.

• Coordinate all the electrotechnical drawings related to the scope.

• Give input to and plan installation and commissioning phase.

• Coordinate technical input and give support to Procurement team within the selection and onboarding process of suppliers.

• Work proactively in close collaboration with overall project managers as well as other technical project managers and specialists.

• Coordinate the technical procurement of materials for the substation

• Execute thorough QA of suppliers’ projects deliverables.

• Coordinate the civil design input with our civil partners.

What You Bring

• Degree in Electrical Engineering (or equivalent) with 5+ years of experience in high voltage substation design and engineering

• Broad knowledge within subsystems included in the substation in any of the following areas: Air Insulated Switchgear, Gas Insulated Switchgear, Oil filled components, compensation systems, HV and MV cable systems and their terminations, Auxiliary systems, civil works

• Has proven experience in working under rules according to the Danish legislation 1608, as well as experience in the field of a High Voltage substations, either as a “Arbejdsleder” or similar position understanding the practicalities on the site.

• Basic understanding of cyber security in projects.

• Thorough understanding of interfaces and design flow between the sub-systems as well as the capability to break down the design work in appropriate steps for planning purposes.

• Project and customer focused combined with strong written and oral communication skills for co-working with technical and non-technical colleagues and stakeholders.

• Proven supplier management skills.

• Fluent English written and spoken. Danish is considered an advantage.

About the Team

At Siemens Energy, our people and their passion for innovation make the difference. You will join a growing team of dedicated Project Managers and Engineers working in a collaborative, international environment. Together, we build the technical expertise and innovative solutions needed to meet increasing energy demands and drive the green energy transition.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Application

Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date. Please submit before 2026-11-10

A Snapshot of Your Day

Join us as a Regional Commodity Manager and become a vital procurement partner for business stakeholders across Northern Europe, focusing primarily on the Danish market. In this dynamic role, you will lead the implementation of procurement strategies, governance, and sourcing initiatives while managing supplier relationships. You will collaborate closely with the Indirect Materials organization, identifying commercial opportunities and contributing to sourcing strategies that drive value through supplier optimization and cost improvements. Engage with regional procurement teams, global commodity managers, and suppliers to enhance procurement performance and create a sustainable business impact.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Drive regional procurement initiatives and implement global sourcing strategies across Northern Europe, particularly in Denmark.

• Develop and execute sourcing, tendering, negotiation, and contract management activities.

• Analyze spending, supplier, and market data to uncover savings opportunities and optimize supplier portfolios.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and our Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) partner to ensure supply continuity and support business objectives.

• Promote procurement governance and compliance while monitoring supplier performance and driving continuous improvement initiatives.

What You Bring

• A Master’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, or a related field.

• Several years of experience in procurement, category management, or strategic sourcing within an international and matrix-based organization.

• Strong analytical, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with a balance of strategic thinking and pragmatic execution.

• Experience in indirect materials procurement and supplier management, with knowledge of procurement governance and buying channel strategies.

• Fluent English skills are required; additional Nordic language skills are a plus.

About the Team

You will be part of Siemens Energy’s Procurement organization, joining a collaborative team focused on indirect materials. This role offers a unique opportunity to bridge regional procurement leadership and commodity management. You will enhance stakeholder engagement while supporting the development and implementation of category strategies within Office & Factory Supplies. Together with colleagues across Procurement and our BPO partner, you will contribute to Siemens Energy’s procurement transformation, driving standardization, digitalization, and sustainable value creation.

Who is Siemens Gamesa?

Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community.

At Siemens Gamesa, we are constantly seeking talented individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Gamesa: https://www.siemens-energy.com/global/en/home/careers/working-with-us.html

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

Here are examples of the rewards and benefits Siemens Energy offers:

• Opportunities to work with a global team

• Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects

• Medical benefits

• Remote/Flexible work

• Time off/Paid holidays and parental leave

• Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens-Energy platform

• Access to a variety of employee resource groups

Don’t hesitate to apply before the 10th November 2026. Ongoing selection is applied; the role might be filled before the last application date.

Help grow Awaze’s commercial footprint across Germany, Austria and Switzerland by building high-performing travel agency relationships and strategic partnerships that bring our holidays to even more guests.

**Your mission

**As our new Senior Partnership Account Manager, your mission is to grow Awaze’s commercial footprint across the DACH region through two interconnected areas: developing our travel agency channel and building strategic commercial partnerships.

As you’ll be working directly with travel agencies and partners across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, you’ll need to be fluent in German, at native or near-native level, as well as confident communicating professionally in English.

You’ll own and grow relationships with travel agencies across the region, lead agencies through the transition from legacy booking systems to Awaze’s modern platform, and identify new opportunities to expand our network. Alongside this, you’ll develop strategic partnerships from initial prospecting and negotiation through to onboarding and ongoing account development.

Working closely with Marketing, Product, Commercial and leadership teams, you’ll use market insight and performance data to strengthen partner engagement, extend Awaze’s reach and deliver measurable commercial impact.

**What You'll Be Doing

**

• Own and develop relationships with travel agencies across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, with a particular focus on chains and networks.

• Lead the end-to-end transition of agencies from legacy booking systems to Awaze’s modern platform, including change management, training and onboarding.

• Identify, develop and onboard new travel agency partners, maintaining a strong pipeline of prospective agencies.

• Proactively identify, pursue, negotiate and close new strategic commercial partnerships across the DACH region.

• Manage the full partnership lifecycle, from initial outreach and commercial negotiation through to onboarding and ongoing account development.

• Monitor agency and partnership performance, using data and commercial metrics to identify opportunities for increased adoption, engagement and growth.

• Collaborate with Marketing, Product and Commercial teams to ensure partners are effectively supported and positioned for success.

• Identify co-marketing and co-branding opportunities that create mutual value and extend Awaze’s reach and brand presence.

• Act as a source of DACH market intelligence, sharing relevant trends, partner feedback and commercial insights with leadership and product teams.

• Travel regularly across the DACH region to build and strengthen relationships with agencies and strategic partners.

**Who We’re Looking For

**You’ll thrive in this role if you’re a natural relationship builder who enjoys turning commercial opportunities into long-term, mutually valuable partnerships. You’re comfortable taking ownership of a varied portfolio, confident working independently and equally at home discussing performance data, negotiating a new partnership or helping an established agency embrace a new way of working.

Fluent German, at native or near-native level, is an essential requirement for this role. You’ll use German regularly to build trusted relationships and communicate effectively with travel agencies and strategic partners across the DACH region.

**We’re Looking For Someone Who Brings

**

• Several years of experience in account management, partnerships or business development, ideally within travel, hospitality or a related sector.

• A demonstrable track record of growing accounts and closing partnerships that deliver measurable commercial outcomes.

• Fluent German, at native or near-native level, alongside strong professional English, both written and spoken.

• Strong relationship-building, communication and presentation skills, with the credibility to engage agency owners, commercial partners and senior stakeholders.

• Strong analytical capabilities and confidence using performance data and commercial metrics to inform decisions and identify opportunities.

• An understanding of brand and marketing principles and the ability to represent Awaze consistently with external partners.

• A self-motivated and structured approach, with the ability to independently manage a large and varied account portfolio.

• Willingness and ability to travel regularly across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, as well as other locations when required.

• Bonus points if you have experience within the DACH travel agency landscape, legacy travel booking systems or digital platform transitions, or have worked within or alongside a major European travel group.

• An established network across DACH travel agencies or hospitality chains, or experience with GDS tools and partnership management platforms, would also be an advantage.

**How You'll Make An Impact

**

• Successfully transition and onboard travel agencies onto Awaze’s modern platform, driving strong adoption and engagement.

• Grow the number, quality and performance of active travel agency relationships across the DACH region.

• Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of prospective agencies and strategic partners, progressing opportunities through to successful commercial agreements.

• Strengthen retention, satisfaction and commercial performance across your agency and partnership portfolio.

• Turn performance data into clear insights and recommendations that help both our partners and internal teams make better commercial decisions.

• Work across Marketing, Product and Commercial teams to unlock partner support, co-marketing opportunities and additional commercial value.

• Bring relevant DACH market trends, partner feedback and insights into Awaze to help inform product and business decisions.

• Champion Awaze’s brands and standards across every agency and partner interaction.

**Why you’ll want to work at Awaze

**We offer a versatile position in a strong professional and social environment - one you’ll have the opportunity to influence and help shape. You’ll be part of an international company that invests in the future, and join a dynamic, fast-paced department with skilled and committed colleagues who support each other.

We’re a People-first Business - And We Know That Our Success Starts With Our Teams. Here’s a Glimpse Of What You’ll Enjoy

• Generous discounts on holidays across our brands

• Flexible hybrid working – with the autonomy to work how you work best

• Real opportunities to grow, learn and shape your role as well as careers progression vertically or horizontally, cross countries and responsibilities.

**About Awaze

**Our mission is clear - to create amazing holidays with Europe’s widest choice of holiday homes.

With more than 110,000 properties across Europe, we are the largest managed vacation rentals business in the region. Our ambition is not only to be the biggest, but the best provider of holiday homes in Europe.

As travel continues to evolve, we are focused on what comes next. We will keep strengthening our relationships with guests and homeowners, continuously improving the way we work, and delivering strong performance. By making things simpler and smarter, we are building a business that is ready for what’s next - powered by proud, passionate and inclusive people.

**Worth knowing

**

• This role can be based remotely in Germany or from our Virum office in Denmark.

• Regular travel across Germany, Austria and Switzerland will be an important part of the role, with travel to other locations when required.

**What’s next?

**If this sounds like the right next step for you, hit “Apply” and follow the instructions to submit your application. We tailor our recruitment process to each role to give both you and our hiring teams the best possible chance to assess whether this could be the start of a successful collaboration. You’ll hear from us shortly after we’ve reviewed your application.

We’re committed to running an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment, and if you have any specific requirements or adjustments needed for the interview, just let us know when you accept your invitation - we’re happy to accommodate.

Do you enjoy handling all kinds of user’s questions related to computers? Are you passionate about IT support? If both answers are yes, we can offer you a challenging position, great colleagues and the opportunity to combine your education with hand-on experience in a global company.

Responsibilities and challenges

You will be part of a Global IT support team, and you will work closely with IT colleagues all over the world.

Your main responsibilities

• Be able to respond to any user question (a good answer can also be, that you don’t know, but you will talk to somebody else, and get back to them)

• Keep an eye on IT hardware stock

• Deployment of laptops

• Registering hardware in our internal system

• Introducing new colleagues to their laptops and our IT products and systems.

• Help global users by creating wiki-guides.

• Help with setting up screens, docking stations, meeting rooms etc.

• Challenge us with open-minded questions related to our work 😊

Qualifications and personal skills

We are looking for a proactive person who isn’t afraid to ask when something is unclear, and who can also work and solve problems on own initiative, and independently.

You should have following qualifications:

• You are in the main part (Hovedforløb) of IT Support education (or are starting soon) on technical education and searching for “praktik”

• You have helped your family or friends with IT challenges before and you are familiar with all kinds of basic issues

• You are self-paced, but also have good time management skills

• You are service minded and like to talk to users

• You are always ready to improve and develop your IT skills

• It is an advantage to have knowledge of Windows 10, Active Directory, Basic network setups, and general knowledge concerning troubleshooting IT problems.

• You are fluent in English and Danish

We offer

To work at DHI means being part of an organization that is the global leader in solving the world’s toughest challenges in water environments. We will offer you:

• A versatile and challenging job with focus on developing and expanding your skills

• Close interaction with Operations, Network, Business Systems and colleagues around the world

• Nice office space and equipment in DHI’s headquarter in a green surrounding in Hørsholm

• Delicious lunch served in our own canteen and a daily supply of fruit, coffee and tea

• A company and colleagues that are keen on developing your skills.

• Fun and varied company events like Friday bars, seasonal parties and outings.

Office location

Hørsholm, Denmark - 25 km north of Copenhagen.

Application / next step

There is no deadline, but we will hold interviews on ongoing basis. We are aiming to find the right candidate as soon as possible.

DHI are the first people you should call when you have a tough challenge to solve in a water environment – be it a river, a reservoir, an ocean, a coastline, within a city or a factory.

Our knowledge of water environments is second-to-none. It represents 50 years of dedicated research and real-life experience from more than 140 countries. We strive to make this knowledge globally accessible to clients and partners by channelling it through our local teams and unique software.

Our world is water. So whether you need to save water, share it fairly, improve its quality, quantify its impact or manage its flow, we can help. Our knowledge, combined with our team's expertise and the power of our technology, holds the key to unlocking the right solution.

For more information please visit www.dhigroup.com

Join us in this role where you’ll act as the accounting lead on some of the world’s largest and most complex renewable energy transactions. Your IFRS expertise will help shape transaction structures and inform key investment decisions. You’ll assess the accounting implications of complex M&A transactions, advise on proposed structures, and translate your conclusions into clear insights that support commercial decisions.

**Welcome to IC Projects & IFRS

**You’ll be part of IC Projects & IFRS where you will act as the accounting lead on M&A transactions including acquisitions, divestments, farm-downs, joint ventures, and strategic partnerships. You’ll join a highly specialised team of eight accounting professionals and work closely with our Partnerships and M&A organisation, external advisers, auditors, and a team of around 40 M&A professionals who originate and execute transactions across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific. In this role, you’ll support complex international transactions and help ensure high-quality accounting decisions across the Group.

As a team, we share knowledge, explore complex accounting questions together, and support one another in delivering high-quality advice. We value different perspectives, open dialogue, flexibility, and a healthy work-life balance.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• acting as the IFRS accounting lead on acquisitions, divestments, farm-downs, joint ventures, structured financing arrangements, and strategic partnerships

• assessing accounting implications early in the transaction process and advising on proposed deal and investment structures

• preparing clear IFRS accounting assessments and technical memos that support commercial and management decisions

• reviewing draft contracts, term sheets, bid materials, and other transaction documentation from an accounting perspective

• participating in meetings with investors, external advisers, auditors, and internal stakeholders on transaction-related accounting matters

• contributing to wider Group Finance activities, including financial reporting, accounting policy development, and strategic accounting projects.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• bring deep IFRS expertise gained through technical accounting, IFRS advisory or a similar specialist environment

• have experience advising on the IFRS implications of M&A transactions within a listed company, international group, professional services firm, or a comparable organisation

• can translate complex accounting matters into clear, practical conclusions for management, commercial colleagues, and other non-accounting stakeholders

• build strong working relationships and communicate confidently across finance, Partnerships & M&A, management, external advisers, and auditors

• approach complex assignments analytically and systematically, take ownership of your work, and remain adaptable to changing transaction priorities

• hold a master’s degree in accounting, auditing, or a related discipline.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11% contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3% holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and wellbeing programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Certain positions may require a background check as part of the hiring process. If applicable, you will be informed during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

• Leading commercial evaluation of risks and opportunities facing your projects,

• Preparation and presentation of project specific sales forecasts and budgets to high-level management,

• Working with the commercial team to establish and implement efficient processes and best practices.

• A passion for renewable energy and a sense of the importance to lead the change,

• Knowledge of customer business case, preferably for energy projects,

• Demonstrable commercial contract management skills including in commercial negotiations, preferably within sales and/or the energy or construction sector,

• An ability to communicate technically complicated topics concisely to high-level management and customers in a high-pressure environment,

• A good knowledge of cost calculation approaches, finance methods, and commercial financial topics (bonds, escalation, currency, indemnities, liabilities, etc.),

• Project management skills,

• Fluency in English, both orally and in writing, International experience and willingness to travel (25%) and work in a global environment,

**About Flatpay

You’ll help build and evolve event-driven ETL/ELT pipelines for lead intake, routing, and enrichment, as well as the data platform that powers marketing insights.

What you'll do

• 
Design, build, and operate lead flow pipelines, including monitoring and alerting to ensure reliability

• 
Contribute to the development of internal tools and frameworks for marketing data ingestion and transformation

• 
Enable self-service analytics by structuring clean, well-documented datasets for dashboards and reporting tools

• 
Partner with marketing analysts and stakeholders to translate business needs into robust data solutions

•

•

• 
Experience with CI/CD workflows, version control (e.g., Git), and testing best practices

_Asa Consulting Solution Architect for the Data Management domain, you will serve as a trusted advisor throughout consulting engagements — helping clients shape feasible solution options, leading or supporting the design of custom, high‑value solutions, and ensuring strong domain integrity aligned with the broader SimCorp One solution design. You will play a central role in supporting scalable, high‑quality custom implementations and contribute to consistency and excellence across our Consulting organization.

You will collaborate closely with colleagues across Consulting, Product Management, and Value Streams to ensure our custom solutions remain both feasible and aligned to SimCorp standards. You will also help advance our practices, strengthen our knowledge base, and mentor the next generation of solutioning talent within SimCorp.

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**As SimCorp embarks on the SimCorp One journey, the Consulting Solution Architect plays a critical role in enabling the Consulting organization to deliver high‑quality, scalable custom solutions. Consulting Solution Architects ensure that custom client requirements are shaped and delivered with strong domain integrity, consistency, and alignment with SimCorp’s delivery methodologies (Compass) and the SimCorp One solution.

jobs.occupation: Postdoc Position: Endocrine Disruption in Fish with Focus on Histopathological Endpoint Development
jobs.description:
We invite applicants for a 3½-years Postdoctoral research position in Environmental Toxicology with a focus on histopathological and behavioral endpoints development in fish. The position is funded by the EU Partnership for Risk Assessment of Chemicals (PARC), the Danish EPA and University of Southern Denmark (SDU). The project will be carried out in the Ecotoxicology group at the Department of Biology, SDU. 

Qualifications: 
The successful candidate must hold a PhD degree in Environmental Toxicology. A strong background in chemical risk and hazard assessment and regulatory toxicology is highly appreciated. This includes knowledge of EU chemicals legislation and regulatory frameworks such as REACH, OECD test guidelines, AOP development, and/or pesticide and biocide risk assessment. Furthermore, the following experiences and skills are required: 

• 
Strong proficiency in English, both written and verbal. 

• 
Experience in teaching and supervision at the university level, including lectures, student examinations, and supervision of MSc students. 

• 
Hands-on experience in assessing endocrine disruption properties of chemicals using the Zebrafish (Danio rerio) model.  

• 
Strong documented knowledge of one or more endocrine pathways relevant to EU regulatory assessments (EATS modalities). 

• 
Extensive experience with OECD fish test protocols such as OECD TG 236 and OECD TG 210. 

• 
Documented experience in histopathology techniques, including tissue preparation, microtome sectioning, cryosectioning, H&E staining, microscopy, and image analysis. 

• 
Experience in behavioral assessment in zebrafish eleutheroembryos, e.g., using EthoVision XT or equivalent tracking and analysis software. 

The following qualifications are considered advantageous: 

• 
Experience with molecular biology techniques, including gene expression analysis (e.g., qPCR, transcriptomics). 

• 
Experience with immunohistochemistry and related imaging techniques. 

This position is particularly suited for a candidate with strong interest in bridging experimental ecotoxicology and regulatory chemical risk- and hazard assessment. 

Application deadline: 13. November 2026 at 23:59 hours local Danish time. 
Please see the full call, including how to apply, on www.sdu.dk

jobs.occupation: Laboratory Technician with Upstream/Recovery Process Experience
jobs.description:
**Laboratory Technician With Upstream/Recovery Process Experience

**Bagsværd, Denmark

**Your impact begins here

**Bring your practical laboratory skills into a role where your work will help develop, optimise and troubleshoot API processes. As a Laboratory Technician, you will support recovery activities connected to our yeast fermentation platform, working hands-on with chromatography, filtration and centrifugation. Your attention to detail and curiosity will help us run reliable experiments, improve our processes and address challenges that arise in production.

**What You'll Bring

**You enjoy practical laboratory work and bring a structured approach to experiments, equipment and data. You can take ownership of your tasks while working closely with colleagues in a changing laboratory environment.

**To Succeed In This Role, We Expect You To

**

• Hold a qualification as a laboratory technician, process technologist or in a related discipline.

• Have practical experience with upstream or downstream processes.

• Bring hands-on laboratory experience for recovery processes, ideally including fermentation.

• Work with attention to detail, both independently and as part of a team.

• Take initiative, identify what needs to be done and follow tasks through to completion.

• Communicate confidently in English, the primary working language of the team.

You will also benefit from being curious and open to learning, particularly as tasks and priorities can change. Strong collaboration and a service-oriented approach will help you build effective working relationships across the team.

**What You'll Do

**Your work will centre on recovery processes and the practical laboratory activities needed to develop and optimise them. You will:

• Perform recovery activities using laboratory processes and equipment including chromatography (ÄKTA), filtration and centrifugation.

• Conduct experiments and analyse the resulting data.

• Prepare laboratory equipment and materials and help keep them ready for reliable use.

• Support the development and optimisation of recovery processes within the yeast fermentation platform.

• Help troubleshoot and resolve production process challenges through laboratory-scale work.

• Carry out your work in accordance with safety requirements and good laboratory practice.

**Who You'll Work With

**You will join API MSAT Process Upstream 2, a team working at the interface between development and production. The team currently consists of 11 scientists and specialists and seven laboratory technicians.

Together, the team develops and optimises API processes at laboratory scale, conducts experiments, tests and measurements, and supports the troubleshooting of production process challenges. Your laboratory environment will include fermentation, chromatography using ÄKTA systems, filtration and centrifugation.

You will work closely with colleagues who combine scientific and practical laboratory expertise, contributing your own hands-on perspective while learning from others. The team also shares responsibility for maintaining its laboratories and keeping equipment in reliable working condition.

**What You Can Expect Here

**At Novo Nordisk, you will have the opportunity to work hands-on with advanced laboratory technologies while contributing to the development and optimisation of processes that support our work in medicines. You will be part of an environment where curiosity, continuous improvement and collaboration are important to how the team approaches its work.

The role gives you opportunities to develop your laboratory capabilities while taking ownership of practical activities and contributing to solving real process challenges.

**What We Offer

**Salary and Benefits: The Annual Base Salary for a Laboratory Technician ranges from DKK 437,600-643,200, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

A competitive benefits package is offered, including a pension scheme (currently 13% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution) in accordance with the applicable Collective Agreement for Salaried Employees (Indutriens Funktionæroverenskomst or “IFO”).

Benefits package also include a free choice account of currently 10% and 4% holiday allowance.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today.

If you are ready to bring your laboratory experience to recovery processes and contribute to developing and optimising our work in Bagsværd, apply for the Laboratory Technician with Upstream/Recovery Process Experience role by 18 November 2026.

For further information, please contact Hiring Manager Claus Juul-Mortensen on +45 30759732.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Good decisions start with good data. But good data does not just happen. At NORDEN, data comes from many places and is used across our business to understand markets, automate processes and make better decisions. Your job is to make sure that data is actually ready to be used.

As our new Data Engineer, you will build the pipelines and datasets that move data through our organisation and turn raw information into something people can trust and work with.

You will not be sitting far away from the business maintaining pipelines no one really talks about. You will work closely with digital and commercial colleagues, understand what they need and build the data foundation that helps them solve real problems.

And while shipping knowledge is something you will pick up along the way, curiosity about data and how to make it useful is something we hope you bring from day one.

Why this role?

Because there is a lot to build, improve and figure out.

You will join nine colleagues in our Data Engineering team in Copenhagen, working with large and varied datasets using PySpark, SQL, Azure DevOps and Microsoft Fabric. And our team is growing beyond Copenhagen. We are setting up a Data Engineering team in Singapore, starting with two colleagues, giving you an even broader team to work and share ideas with.

Some days will be about building something new. Others will be about improving what already exists, finding a smarter way to structure data or figuring out why something is not working quite as expected.

What connects it all is the purpose behind it: making data easier to trust, access and use across NORDEN.

You already know your way around data engineering. Now you are looking for a role where you can have more of a say in how things are built, not just build what has already been decided.

You will manage your solutions, contribute to technical decisions and collaborate closely with the business to understand what our data needs to do.

What you will be doing

You will work across the journey from raw data to reliable datasets that colleagues and systems across NORDEN can actually use.

You will:

• Build and maintain scalable data pipelines.

• Bring internal and external data together and turn it into trusted datasets.

• Transform raw data into useful features and insights.

• Improve how we capture, validate and enrich data.

• Build solutions that are reliable today without making life difficult for whoever needs to work with them tomorrow.

• Work with digital and commercial colleagues to understand what they need from our data and translate that into technical solutions.

What you bring

You know that good data solutions are not only about getting things to work, but about making them reliable, scalable and useful to others.

Besides this you likely have:

• Around 5 years of practical experience in data engineering or a similar role.

• A degree within data, IT, engineering or another analytical field.

• Eligibility to work in Denmark.

• Solid experience with Lakehouse architecture, for example in Microsoft Fabric or Azure Databricks.

• Experience designing and building data pipelines and working with how data is structured, transformed and made available to others.

• Experience contributing to technical decisions around data architecture and how data should be structured and used.

• The confidence to be responsible for your solutions, while still enjoying sparring with and learning from others.

• Good English communication skills, both written and spoken.

Application

Please upload your motivation letter, resume and relevant diplomas via our website as soon as possible and no later than 20 November 2026. Our company

We are a global provider of ocean-based freight services for bulk and project cargo of all sizes. We integrate freight solutions with port logistics, helping our customers optimise and decarbonise supply chains. We provide tailored solutions built on flexibility, reliability, and intelligence.

Our agile business model ensures stability by continuously adapting our fleet to market developments and customer needs.

Founded in 1871, NORDEN is one of Denmark’s oldest internationally operating shipping companies. Incorporated in Denmark, we are listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen as part of the OMX Nordic Large Cap index.

With offices across 6 continents, we are a truly integrated part of global trade.

You know shipping. Now you can use that knowledge in a completely different way.

At NORDEN, our core business applications sit right at the heart of how our commercial teams work. But getting the most out of them is not only about the technology. It is about understanding how shipping actually works, how people use the systems every day and where things could work better.

As our new Business Application Manager, you will bring your shipping experience into that space.

You will work with colleagues across NORDEN to improve how we use our core business applications, optimise the processes around them and help turn business needs into better ways of working.

You do not need to come from IT or have worked as a Business Application Manager before. You understand shipping, likely from operations, control/finance or laytime and are curious about how systems and technology can make the business work better.

Why this role?

Because you get to use your shipping knowledge from a completely new angle.

You will join our Business Applications team of six colleagues across Copenhagen, Cyprus and Singapore, working closely with colleagues from the business as well as Digital Services and Solutions.

Your primary focus will be IMOS, but your work will also take you into applications such as SEDNA, PortLog, Shipfix and other tools used across NORDEN.

Some days you might be looking at how a process could work better in IMOS. Others you could be helping colleagues get more out of an application, supporting a new implementation or working with our commercial AI assistant tools.

What connects it all is understanding how people work today and finding ways for our systems and processes to support them better.

Your base will be our office in Hellerup, with occasional travel to other NORDEN offices.

What you will be doing

You will work where shipping, people, processes and technology meet.

You will:

• Analyse how our business applications and surrounding processes are used and identify opportunities to improve them.

• Participate in and lead projects implementing new applications, processes and integrations.

• Train and support colleagues in getting the most out of our applications.

• Work with teams across NORDEN to create better alignment between processes and systems.

• Support and develop the use of our commercial AI assistant tools.

• Work primarily with IMOS while also getting involved with SEDNA, PortLog, Shipfix and other business applications.

What you bring

You do not need to be an IT specialist. What matters most is your understanding of shipping and how these applications are used in practice. You may have used them as an end user up to now, and that experience could be exactly what makes you well suited for this role.

Besides this you likely:

• Have experience from shipping, from operations, control/finance or laytime.

• Have worked with shipping business applications and are familiar with IMOS.

• Are curious about technology, AI and digitalisation and how they can improve the way a business operates.

You are curious about how people work and what could make their day-to-day easier. You listen, ask questions and connect the dots between people, processes and systems, turning what you learn into practical improvements.

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

We are looking for a Product Compliance Manager to join Veo's newly established Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) team.

As Veo continues to grow, we navigate a broad range of regulatory requirements across our products and business, from certifications, product safety, and environmental regulation to market access and broader compliance obligations.

In this role, you will focus on product-related regulatory compliance and certifications, while also working across Veo's broader compliance agenda. You will work closely with colleagues across Hardware, Product Development, Production, Procurement and other parts of the business to understand applicable requirements and help translate them into practical processes and solutions.

You will join a small GRC team with a broad mandate and significant exposure across Veo. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys understanding regulation, technology, and business.

**Key responsibilities:

**

• Coordinate Veo's product certification and market-access activities across relevant markets, working closely with Hardware, Production and other internal stakeholders.

• Monitor and assess new and changing regulatory requirements relevant to Veo and help determine their practical implications for our products and business.

• Develop and maintain a structured overview of regulatory and certification requirements applicable to Veo's products throughout their lifecycle.

• Drive and coordinate implementation of regulatory and compliance requirements across relevant business functions, ensuring clear ownership, appropriate documentation and timely follow-up.

• Work with regulatory frameworks relevant to Veo's products, including areas such as product safety, batteries, electrical and electronic equipment, environmental requirements, waste and recycling obligations and related product compliance requirements.

• Coordinate with external certification bodies, laboratories, consultants and other specialists where required.

• Maintain and develop compliance documentation, certification records, technical files, declarations and other evidence required to demonstrate compliance.

• Support the assessment of regulatory and compliance implications when Veo enters new markets, introduces new products or makes material changes to existing products.

• Support Veo's broader compliance activities, including policies, procedures, monitoring, due diligence, risk assessments and training.

• Support customer, auditor and other stakeholder requests relating to compliance and certifications.

• Contribute to the continued development of Veo's broader GRC framework and take part in cross-functional compliance projects as required.

**Your qualifications:

**

• Relevant higher education in engineering, technology, law, business, quality/compliance, or another relevant discipline.

• Relevant professional experience within product compliance, regulatory compliance, certification, quality/regulatory affairs or a similar area, preferably from an international company.

• Experience working with regulatory requirements affecting hardware or electronic products is an advantage.

• Experience with one or more areas such as product safety, product certifications, battery regulation, electrical/electronic equipment regulation, environmental product requirements, waste/recycling regulation or similar regulatory regimes.

• Experience coordinating certification processes, testing, technical documentation, declarations or interactions with certification bodies and laboratories is highly relevant.

• Broader compliance experience, for example within sanctions and export controls, third-party due diligence, anti-bribery and corruption or other corporate compliance areas, is an advantage.

• An ability to understand complex regulatory requirements and translate them into practical requirements for technical, operational and commercial teams.

• Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with experience coordinating initiatives across different functions and areas of expertise.

• A structured approach to documentation, monitoring and follow-up, combined with the ability to identify and prioritize material compliance risks.

• Strong business understanding and a pragmatic approach to compliance. You should be comfortable finding solutions that meet regulatory requirements while enabling the business to operate effectively.

• Comfortable working independently and taking ownership in an environment where processes and frameworks are still being developed.

• Strong communication skills and professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

At Veo, the Governance, Risk & Compliance team provides oversight, coordination and assurance across the company. We work closely with teams throughout Veo to ensure that regulatory requirements and risks are identified, appropriately owned and effectively managed.

You will report to the Head of Governance, Risk & Compliance and will have considerable opportunity to shape how Veo approaches compliance as the company continues to grow.

Contact Martin Eger Larsen one mel@veo.co if you have any questions

jobs.occupation: Technical Workstream Lead - Procure to Pay 1
jobs.description:
Own the technical backbone for your workstream. As the Technical Workstream Lead for Procure to Pay you sit side-by-side with the Global Process Owner (GPO) and Global Process Leads (GPLs) to translate process design into robust and scalable technology across ERP, PLM, QMS procurement system solutions. You lead the technical scope for your workstream - architecture, build, environments, integrations, data migration, non-functionals, security/compliance, releases, and hyper-care – through stage gates to successful handover.

Ambu is transforming our core enterprise platforms (e.g., ERP, QMS, PLM), and each workstream needs a dedicated technical leader to ensure high-quality, compliant delivery that enables standardized, high-performing global processes.

**The role

**You are the end-to-end technical owner for one workstream. You co-lead the workstream together with the Business Workstream Lead/GPO, ensuring process-system alignment, decision-ready design, disciplined delivery, and operational readiness for your scope.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• 
Technical governance within your workstream

• 
Run technical governance for the workstream. Prepare decision-ready design packs and status for the Design Authority

• 
Own the workstream technical enablement of the Procure to Pay process. Assess run-time/architecture risks, define mitigations, and escalate with clear options

• 
Safeguard solution integrity against enterprise standards and non-functional requirements

• 
Design, build, environments, and release engineering

• 
Lead technical design for your workstream: integrations, extensions, data model, security roles, automation

• 
Define and manage environments for the workstream: branching strategy, CI/CD pipelines, and code quality gates

• 
Manage technical debt, versioning, and change control with impact analysis across upstream/downstream systems

• 
Data migration and cutover

• 
Plan and execute migration tooling, trial loads, reconciliations, and cutover steps for your workstream objects

• 
Security, privacy, and compliance

• 
Ensure cybersecurity, privacy, SoD, and validation/CSV compliance in collaboration with QA/Validation Lead

• 
Delivery orchestration and hyper-care

• 
Coordinate internal platform teams and external vendors for your scope

• 
Lead hyper-care triage and stabilization for the workstream. Complete documentation and knowledge transfer to run

• 
Program collaboration

• 
Partner daily with the GPO, GPLs, and Business Workstream Lead; align on scope, decisions, and adoption

• 
Work with PMO on stage gates, quality reviews, plans, and dependencies to other workstreams

**Your profile

**

• 8+ years delivering technical workstreams on enterprise platforms (ERP, QMS, PLM or similar) in global settings

• Proven leadership of architecture, integrations (API/iPaaS), data migration, and release management within a defined scope

• Strong command of non-functionals: performance, reliability, security, privacy, SoD, and validation/CSV

• Hands-on experience with CI/CD, environment strategy, branching, automation testing, and code quality

• Adept at partnering with GPOs/GPLs to translate future-state processes into scalable solution designs

• Skilled in vendor management and cross-team coordination. Clear, concise communicator in English

• Willingness to travel across Ambu’s footprint and collaborate across time zones

**Nice to have

**

• MedTech/life sciences background (GxP, ISO 13485, 21 CFR Part 11, CSV)

• Exposure to Infor M3 or equivalent ERP, plus PLM, QMS, iPaaS/data platforms, and modern security frameworks

• Experience with Agile-at-scale combined with stage-gate governance

**Key stakeholders for your workstream

**

• Global Process Owner and Global Process Leads

• QA/Validation Lead

• PMO

• External implementation partners and software vendors

**Key Responsibilities Following The Transformation

**

• Participate in approved global projects

• Provide advice for standard systems and best practices of ERP and related systems

• Act as Service Delivery Manager and Subject Matter Expert in ERP in the IT Application Team

• Configure and maintain ERP systems, ensuring alignment with business requirements and best practices.

• Handle system configuration, unit testing, training, and documentation in accordance with standards in close cooperation with external partners.

• Manage Life Cycle Management & release management

• Coach and review work performed by peer professionals

• Work across functions and cultures to deliver high-quality global solutions

• Work independently to solve complex problems

• Train Business Process Owners and other key users

• Follow regulatory compliance

**Ambu – where your technical leadership matters

**Join a fast-growing, international company where your workstream leadership directly enables how we operate globally. We offer strong professional development and a competitive package of professional, social, and financial benefits.

**How To Apply

**Send your CV and a short note describing a program where you led the technical workstream for a specific domain from design through hyper-care, including how you de-risked integrations, data migration, and non-functionals.

We're looking for a marketing intern who wants to manage their own projects and develop creatives that get published.

Great camping experiences start long before guests arrive. At CompuSoft, we build the software that helps campsites turn that first booking into a memorable stay. We’re looking for a marketing intern who wants to take ownership of projects and create content that gets published.

Who We Are

We’re a Danish software company with roots in the camping industry and a story that began in 1987. Today, more than 600 campsites, holiday resorts, attractions, and other tourism businesses use our solutions.

Our technology brings together online booking, guest management, payments, guest apps, and self-service tools. We help businesses simplify daily operations, giving their teams more time to focus on their guests.

With development, sales, and support in-house, we work closely across teams and with our customers to keep improving our solutions.

Your Role:

Your work will cover content, communication, and digital marketing. We’ll shape the internship around your strengths and interests, so tell us what you enjoy working on.

You’ll have your own projects with clear goals and also support the team where needed.

Your tasks may include:

• Writing LinkedIn posts, newsletter articles, and customer stories.

• Creating photos, short videos, and simple graphics.

• Helping plan and run campaigns across our four markets, from trade fairs and webinars to customer events.

• Keeping our messaging clear and consistent across our website, emails, and sales materials.

• Working with our website, email flows, and HubSpot, and tracking results to understand what works.

• Testing new ideas, including ways to use AI tools in our daily marketing work.

...

Who we're looking for

You’re studying marketing, communication, journalism, digital media, or a related subject, and your programme includes an internship.

We hope you:

• Write well in Danish and English. Swedish, Norwegian, or German is a bonus.

• Are curious and enjoy figuring things out independently.

• Have some experience with content, social media, or digital marketing through your studies, work, or personal projects.

• Feel comfortable asking questions and sharing ideas.

You don’t need to know about campsites or software. We’ll teach you that.

What We Offer

You can expect:

• Real responsibility and work you can include in your portfolio.

• A dedicated contact person who makes time for you and provides honest feedback.

• Experience in a growing SaaS company with marketing activities across four markets.

• A place in a team that works closely with sales, product, and customer success.

• A relaxed workplace where we take the work seriously, but not ourselves.

How to Apply

Send a short application and your CV through the application form before December 10. Tell us who you are, what you’d like to work on, and show us one thing you’ve made: a post, an article, a video, or a campaign.

We review applications as they arrive and may fill the position before the deadline.
